people.name: Egypt

translations.web: Therefore the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame, and the refuge in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.
translations.bsb: But Pharaoh’s protection will become your shame, and the refuge of Egypt’s shade your disgrace.
translations.kjv: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.
